items.title: Sync runtime ignore patterns into .gitignore
items.context: Run the managed asset sync for the STALE_SAFE .gitignore drift and verify only the expected runtime ignore patterns are added.
items.userSees: Terminal output no longer includes `STALE_SAFE .gitignore: missing runtime ignore pattern(s): **/owner-lease.json, .koala/locks/`; after DONE, `koala convergence_check` prints `converged: true`.

happy.desc: koala check passes after .gitignore includes **/owner-lease.json and .koala/locks/.

edge.desc: The .gitignore diff is limited to Koala managed runtime ignore patterns and does not change source or story evidence behavior.

adversarial.desc: koala convergence_check remains converged true after the ignore sync.
